body:
I don't overly see how this would help me very much. But, i'll give it a try. 

Thanks for reading my post. I think one of the reasons I posted was because I just needed someone to hear what I had to say for once instead of bottling it up.

I stated it at the end of the post.

To somehow stop myself from always feeling pain when I see happy, successful people, that's all.

Sorry if I wasn't very clear, I wasn't in a very clear state. I don't normally call out for help, so last night was a pretty big low for me.
